name: vertexMap
complete_raw_header: def vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient) (x : Ambient) : Ambient :=

name: vertexMap_coordinate
complete_raw_header:
theorem vertexMap_coordinate (v : Fin 9 → Ambient)
    (x : Ambient) (i : Fin 8) :
    vertexMap v x i = affine (fun k => v k i) x :=

name: affine_constant
complete_raw_header:
theorem affine_constant (a : ℝ) (x : Ambient) :
    affine (fun _ : Fin 9 => a) x = a :=

name: affine_add
complete_raw_header:
theorem affine_add (a b : Fin 9 → ℝ) (x : Ambient) :
    affine (fun k => a k + b k) x = affine a x + affine b x :=

name: affine_sub
complete_raw_header:
theorem affine_sub (a b : Fin 9 → ℝ) (x : Ambient) :
    affine (fun k => a k - b k) x = affine a x - affine b x :=

name: affine_div
complete_raw_header:
theorem affine_div (a : Fin 9 → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (x : Ambient) :
    affine (fun k => a k / c) x = affine a x / c :=

name: affine_sum
complete_raw_header:
theorem affine_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → Fin 9 → ℝ)
    (x : Ambient) :
    affine (fun k => ∑ i, a i k) x = ∑ i, affine (a i) x :=

name: vertexMap_zero
complete_raw_header: theorem vertexMap_zero (v : Fin 9 → Ambient) : vertexMap v 0 = v 0 :=

name: vertexMap_single
complete_raw_header:
theorem vertexMap_single (v : Fin 9 → Ambient) (j : Fin 8) :
    vertexMap v (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ)) = v j.succ :=

name: physicalR_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem physicalR_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient) (x : Ambient) :
    physicalR (vertexMap v x) = affine (fun k => physicalR (v k)) x :=

name: physicalM_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem physicalM_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient) (x : Ambient) :

name: physicalGap_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem physicalGap_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient) (x : Ambient) :

name: coordinateSum_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem coordinateSum_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient) (x : Ambient) :

name: physicalFactor_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem physicalFactor_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient) (x : Ambient)
    (j : Fin 10) :
    physicalFactor j (vertexMap v x) =
      affine (fun k => physicalFactor j (v k)) x :=

name: normalizedFactor_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem normalizedFactor_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient)
    (means : Fin 10 → ℝ) (x : Ambient) (j : Fin 10) :
    normalizedFactor means j (vertexMap v x) =
      affine (fun k => normalizedFactor means j (v k)) x :=

theorem physicalY_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient)
    (means : Fin 10 → ℝ) (U : ℝ) (x : Ambient) :

name: physicalDeviation_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem physicalDeviation_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient)
    (means : Fin 10 → ℝ) (x : Ambient) (j : Fin 10) :

name: physicalMixedIntegrand_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem physicalMixedIntegrand_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient)
    (means : Fin 10 → ℝ) (U : ℝ) (j : Fin 10) (x : Ambient) :
    physicalMixedIntegrand means U j (vertexMap v x) =
      affine (fun k => physicalGap (v k)) x *
      affine (fun k => physicalY means U (v k)) x *
      (affine (fun k => physicalDeviation means j (v k)) x)^2 :=

name: physicalUpperIntegrand_vertexMap
complete_raw_header:
theorem physicalUpperIntegrand_vertexMap (v : Fin 9 → Ambient)
    (x : Ambient) :
    physicalUpperIntegrand (vertexMap v x) =
      4 * affine (fun k => physicalGap (v k)) x /
        ∏ j : Fin 10, affine (fun k => physicalFactor j (v k)) x :=
